attempts.note: exhausted 6000 nodes, no level-up. fresh_env replay throughput ~19 nodes/sec.

A first full run (blind dc16 + source dc24 + source dc48/90k) was cut off after ~24 min mid-deepest-attempt without a gate pass; a second bounded run's blind dc16 attempt alone consumed 309.5s (6000 nodes) so the source-heuristic re-runs did not complete in budget. The fresh_env branch-mode replay cost is the bottleneck: each node mints a fresh env and replays the 11-label L1 prefix + path, ~19 nodes/sec, making depth-capped joint best-first over a 4-block x 8-action sokoban intractable in reasonable wall-time.

methodology_note: ka59 L2 is a size-matched sokoban: 4 movable blocks (tag 0022vrxelxosfy) must each be pushed onto a size-matching target (tag 0010xzmuziohuf) at exactly (target.x+1,target.y+1) with block.w==target.w-2 and block.h==target.h-2 -- win predicate dbmlcqbquh/dujiampjkx read directly from environment_files/ka59/38d34dbb/ka59.py. L1 (action-delta RE) found the existing adapter labels ('1','2','3','4' = move selected block 3px up/down/left/right for 1 step; 'C:i' = click-select block i) are already the complete action vocabulary -- NO missing action (verified block 0 slides cleanly 3px/action toward its (51,51) target). L2 (bigger budget) and L3 (source-derived goal-distance heuristic = sum of min Manhattan distances from size-matching blocks to target destinations, which gives a real gradient: start dist 135) were both attempted. NO attempt passed kit.reproduce() for level>1. Root blocker: the adapter's branch_mode='fresh_env' makes search throughput ~19 nodes/sec (each node = fresh env + 11-label prefix replay), so a depth-capped joint best-first search over the 4-block x 8-action branching cannot reach the ~50+ -action win within tractable wall-time. Clean honest negative -- the deepen well is documented dry.
